messages:
Jamie (Sales): Hey team — customer 'Orphic Labs' wants a hosted POC next Wednesday 09:00-11:00 UTC. Can we open a short safety window for higher sustained throughput (not an unbounded burst)? They're asking for a scoped sandbox key + IP allowlist for that 2h window. Expected pattern: ~60 req/min typical, short spikes up to ~120 req/min for 8–12min intervals. Model: redwood-large-v1, avg ~800 tokens per response. Region: eu-west. No PII (sanitized).

Eli (Solutions Eng): Got it. Can you confirm the endpoint (chat vs text) and whether they need streaming? Also want an estimate of total tokens for billing — rough upper bound OK.

Jamie (Sales): Chat endpoint with streaming=enabled. We'll estimate upper bound 120 req/min * 800 tokens * 120 minutes = ~11.5M tokens worst-case; realistic expected ~3–4M tokens. Customer prefers usage billing; no PO before POC.

Mike (Infra): For hosted quota changes we need: org ID, exact IPs to allowlist, and a risk signoff that no customer PII will be processed. Also confirm whether they need a SCOPED key that expires automatically.

Jamie (Sales): Org ID: org-orp-334. IPs: 52.210.34.0/24 and 18.132.11.7 (static). Key should expire at 11:30 UTC (30m buffer). I'll ping the customer for a quick signed confirmation on data handling.

Sam (Oncall): Please open an ops ticket for the window (include timestamps + org ID). Tag @ops-rate. I'll standby to monitor latency and error spike. Add a fallback model in case of capacity limits.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-4521: \"POC safety window — Orphic Labs (org-orp-334)\" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-4521

Mike (Infra): @ops-rate (cc Eli) — we can do a scoped hosted key + time-limited soft quota for that org. We'll apply a per-minute token quota and route their traffic to eu-west pool. We need final approval from finance for potential overage billing post-POC (since no PO).

Eli (Solutions Eng): For the scoped key can we also apply a per-route limit so the customer can't hammer the embeddings route by mistake? They only need /v1/chat/completions. Also set log-sampling at 5% for eval.

Mike (Infra): Yep — per-route enforcement available. We'll whitelist only /v1/chat/completions and block embeddings/rerank. Log-sampling set to 5%.

ops-bot: Scoped key created (partial): sk-sbox-orp-****abcd — expires 2026-06-11T11:30:00Z — applied per-minute token soft-quota 150 req/min equivalent (sustained), per-route allowlist. Ticket RW-4521 updated.

Jamie (Sales): Perfect — thanks. Can you confirm what the automatic fallback is if the eu-west pool hits capacity? Customer wants reliability guarantees during the demo.

Mike (Infra): Fallback policy: automatic route to redwood-medium-v1 in eu-west for new requests if latency > 500ms or if capacity exhausted; streaming requests may be cut to non-streaming fallback. We'll also enable priority for canary keys for the window.

Eli (Solutions Eng): Noted. I'll tell the customer they get an isolated scoped key, per-route limits, and a fallback to medium model if we hit system limits. Please keep monitoring and ping this thread if any throttling is observed.

Jamie (Sales): Sending confirmation to Orphic now. Thanks all :thumbsup: :sparkles:

Sam (Oncall): I'll monitor RW-4521 during the window and post a short summary after.

ops-bot: RW-4521 -> status: scheduled -> monitoring enabled

Jamie (Sales): Closing the loop here — customer confirmed sandbox key works. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :raised_hands:
